an3.116:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā, paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā, nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāso ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an3.116:1.4: So tad assādeti tan nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. Tatra ṭhito tad adhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno ākāsānañcāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an3.116:1.5: Ākāsānañcāyatanūpagānaṃ bhikkhave devānaṃ vīsatiṃ kappasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an3.116:1.6: Tatra puthujjano yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayam pi gacchati tiracchānayonim pi gacchati pettivisayam pi gacchati.
an3.116:1.7: Bhagavato pana sāvako tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā tasmiṃ yeva bhave parinibbāyati.
an3.116:1.8: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyoso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā uppattiyā sati. 2.
an3.116:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇan ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an3.116:2.2: So tad assādeti tan nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. Tatra ṭhito tad adhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno viññāṇañcāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an3.116:2.3: Viññāṇañcāyatanūpagānaṃ bhikkhave devānaṃ cattārīsaṃ kappasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an3.116:2.4: Tattha puthujjano yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayam pi gacchati tiracchānayonim pi gacchati pettivisayam pi gacchati.
an3.116:2.5: Bhagavato pana sāvako tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamānaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā tasmiṃ yeva bhave parinibbāyati.
an3.116:2.6: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyoso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā uppattiyā sati. 3.
an3.116:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma n' atthi kiñcī ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an3.116:3.2: So tad assādeti tan nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. Tatra ṭhito tad adhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno ākiñcaññāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an3.116:3.3: Ākiñcaññāyatanūpagānaṃ bhikkhave devānaṃ saṭṭhiṃ kappasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an3.116:3.4: Tattha puthujjano yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayam pi gacchati tiracchānayonim pi gacchati pettivisayam pi gacchati.
an3.116:3.5: Bhagavato pana sāvako tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā tasmiṃ yeva bhave parinibbāyati.
an3.116:3.6: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyoso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā uppattiyā sati.
an3.116:3.7: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin
